Name: Flower Syrup Maker
Author: LilacSweetie
Description:
[i]Hello, I'm Lilac! [/i]
Every spring I like to make homemade flower syrup from the flowers that grow in my area! This year I decided I wanted to be able to do that in Stardew Valley as well, so I made this mod that adds a fun new feature for what to do with flowers in the game!

[b]~ ABOUT THIS MOD ~[/b]

This mod adds a functioning flower syrup maker to the game that lets you use one sugar and one flower to make flower flavored syrup! The machine and its' recipe can be bought at Pierre's. The flower syrup gets its own unique name, color, price and quality based on the flower you use. It's edible (or drinkable i suppose) and can be gifted!

[b]~ FUTURE PLANS FOR THIS MOD ~[/b]

As of right now the flower syrup is a universal like, but i want to work on giving it unique gift tastes based on who it's gifted to. I'm still figuring out how to code these things so it might take me a minute, but I'm having a lot of fun with it! Please don't hesitate to let me know if anything's weird or not working correctly in my code so I can fix it.
